title: 400 'Unsupported parameter: max_tokens is not supported with this model' on reasoning models
symptoms: Unsupported parameter: 'max_tokens' is not supported with this model. Use 'max_completion_tokens' instead.
Code that worked with gpt-4o fails after switching the model name
cause: max_tokens is deprecated on Chat Completions and is not accepted by reasoning models. The limit there is max_completion_tokens, which also counts hidden reasoning tokens.
fix: Send max_completion_tokens on Chat Completions, or max_output_tokens on the Responses API.
apply: const r = await client.chat.completions.create({ model, messages, max_completion_tokens: 4000 });
affected: OpenAI Chat Completions with o-series and GPT-5 family reasoning models, since o1 (late 2024), checked October 2026
